title: Add /.well-known/security.txt to the website
summary: Tell security researchers where to write, in the standard place.
body: People who find a security problem look for `/.well-known/security.txt` (RFC 9116). Add it to `apps/web` with a contact and an expiry date.
criteria: GET /.well-known/security.txt answers 200 with Contact and Expires
Expires is less than a year ahead
